name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support to farmers for land holdings
benefit: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 per installment, 3 times a year)
eligibility: Family members: farmer, spouse, minor children
applicantType: Small and marginal farmers and landholders
howToApply: Online at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme to protect farmers against crop loss
benefit: Insurance coverage for crop losses due to natural calamities
eligibility: All notified crops in the state
premiumRate: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for horticulture
howToApply: Through insurance company agents or bank branches

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: Agriculture development scheme focused on agriculture infrastructure
benefit: Subsidy for agricultural projects and infrastructure development
applicantType: Individual farmers, farmer groups, agricultural entrepreneurs
coverage: Up to 100% subsidy for identified sub-schemes

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Savings scheme for girl child with agricultural benefits
benefit: Interest rate varies, tax benefits, maturity bonus
howToApply: Any post office or authorized banks

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with soil testing reports
benefit: Free soil testing and personalized fertilizer recommendations
howToApply: Through block agriculture office or online portal
